families.name: Thiên Thời
families.rules: Compares Mệnh element to Đại Vận palace element. Controls = positive, Controlled by = negative, Generates = mild drain, Generated by = highly positive, Same = neutral/supportive.

families.name: Địa Lợi
families.rules: Averages the numeric dignity of principal stars in the active palace. Vô Chính Diệu triggers opposite palace borrowing based on school policy.

families.name: Nhân Hòa
families.rules: Accumulates supportive and pressure scores from auxiliary stars in the active palace and its trines.

families.name: Tứ Hóa
families.rules: Applies Đại Vận stem transformations to stars. Hóa Lộc/Quyền/Khoa are positive modifiers, Hóa Kỵ is a severe negative modifier.

families.name: Severe Pressure Evidence
families.rules: Specific named patterns like Không Kiếp + Hóa Kỵ or Kình Đà + Hỏa Linh trigger non-linear penalties.

families.name: Out of Frame Transformations
families.rules: Transformations affecting palaces outside the Đại Vận trines are currently excluded pending further research.
